Albion Fortress Intermediate Holdings LLC | (6) | (14) | (18) | First Lien - Term Loan | EURIBOR + 575 | 7.8 | 7/31/2031 | EUR par 23,474,732 | amortized cost 26,175 | fair value 26,591 | 2.6

findings.detail: A supplemental foreign-currency Cost/FMV row for Albion Fortress was extracted as a holding with fair_value_currency U_EUR instead of using the USD-denominated schedule fair value row.

rationale: FX02 is a real error for the localized Albion row: the raw source has a supplemental Issuer/Investment Type/Currency/Cost/FMV table where the row is explicitly EUR with FMV 23,005, and the extracted holding carries fair_value_currency U_EUR. The same instrument appears in the main schedule with the par amount in EUR but the valuation columns as schedule fair-value amounts, fair value 26,591. The pipeline therefore let the supplemental foreign-currency FMV representation enter private_markets_holdings as the fair_value currency instead of the BDC schedule fair value convention.
